visual_environment.illumination: Flat, even, receptive light with no dominant source.
visual_environment.palette: Pale neutral fields, muted cools, and low-saturation received color.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Held breath before speech; material arrives and settles before being claimed.
visual_environment.material_effects: Marks remain soft and available; nothing is yet sharpened into a thesis or self-luminous center.

visual_environment.illumination: Clear diagrammatic light that makes distinctions and relations easy to parse.
visual_environment.palette: Cool whites, pale blue-gray, restrained ink-dark lines, and precise local color.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Legible, referential, cool, and slightly distanced.
visual_environment.motion: Pointing, linking, indexing, or outlining rather than striking.
visual_environment.material_effects: Edges clarify; pointers, seams, labels-as-marks, and relational lines gain definition without changing the family's medium.

visual_environment.illumination: Charged high-contrast light concentrated at the decisive contact or gesture.
visual_environment.palette: Stark neutral fields with coral, red, white, or hot accent at the asserted point.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Immediate, forceful, committed, and difficult to withdraw.
visual_environment.motion: Impact, downward/forward strike, or one directional commitment.
visual_environment.density: Sparse except at the point of force.
visual_environment.material_effects: Existing marks sharpen and compress at contact; contrast spikes locally rather than changing the underlying family grammar.

visual_environment.illumination: Narrowed attention: one held object/region is quietly illuminated while surrounding context falls away.
visual_environment.palette: Desaturated field around one retained local color or tonal emphasis.
visual_environment.material_effects: Negative space opens around the chosen form; surrounding marks soften or recede without being erased.

visual_environment.illumination: Structured articulate light at a convergence where separate streams lock into one statement.
visual_environment.palette: Balanced cool/warm fields meeting in a crisp shared accent.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Constructed, explicit, synthetic, and publicly committed.
visual_environment.motion: Convergence and locking rather than mere collision.
visual_environment.density: Moderate, organized around the joining relation.
visual_environment.material_effects: Independent marks align into a common axis, seam, or composite form while retaining evidence of their sources.

visual_environment.illumination: Light originates within the figure/form itself rather than falling on it from outside.
visual_environment.palette: Contained gold-white, warm dawn, and clear surrounding dark or neutral field.
visual_environment.motion: Return toward center, self-recognition, or reciprocal gaze.
visual_environment.density: Moderate around an internally luminous center.
visual_environment.material_effects: Existing forms develop a contained internal glow/clarity; do not replace family composition with generic halos.

visual_environment.illumination: Warm dusk light dimming as accumulated layers become ground.
visual_environment.palette: Amber, ochre, warm gray, muted brown, and darkening residual accents.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Settled, habitual, closing, and ready to become the substrate of the next cycle.
visual_environment.motion: Downward settling, layering, repetition becoming ground.
visual_environment.density: Increasing toward the base or accumulated record.
visual_environment.material_effects: Marks repeat, layer, and lose some individual prominence as they become background structure without disappearing.
